name: Biology: Eterna RNA inverse folding
description: Search for RNA sequences whose independently evaluated minimum-free-energy structures match Eterna100-v2 targets under a folding-call budget.

sources.locator: Eterna100 benchmark target construction and RNA secondary-structure inverse-design protocol.
Official author implementation/data reference; evaluator and seed are independently written, not copied.

requirements.datasets: Pinned source-derived bundle B02.json plus SHA256 manifest under .cache/science-biology; prepare using scripts/prepare_biology_expansion.py. Automatic compact-source staging available.

evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

execution.interface: design(dot_bracket, constraints, oracle) -> ACGU sequence of matching length. constraints uses N for free bases. oracle(sequence) returns (MFE_structure,energy), exposes budget, and rejects calls beyond budget. ViennaRNA 2.6.4, 37 C. Objective fraction of exact deterministic MFE matches. Search runs in trusted protocol (direct engine calls cannot be policed in-process).

provenance.note: New local evaluator and seed based on cited source specifications; official data are reused.
provenance.reuse_scope: ViennaRNA folding engine; local objective and seed

limitations: Twelve public length<=100 Eterna100-v2 targets, 64 oracle calls each. Thermodynamic folding is not experimental structure confirmation; no concealed-motif generalization claim. Exact pinned engine required.
Public source subsets are development-visible. Freeze candidates before evaluating on additional independently chosen studies/instances; trusted candidate execution is not a security sandbox.
Improving this benchmark is a scientific-method result; it does not alone establish a new biological discovery.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Design RNA sequences that fold into a prescribed secondary structure.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Controlling RNA structure supports studies of RNA function and the design of ribozymes and molecular structures.

papers.title: A New Algorithm for RNA Secondary Structure Design
papers.primary_goal: Find RNA sequences predicted to fold into specified target secondary structures.
papers.task_relation: RNA-SSD solves the same inverse-folding problem as the local Eterna100-v2 task. Local structures and folding-call limits differ; agreement with a minimum-free-energy model does not establish experimental folding or biological function.
